## Behaviour

Describe the trigger, resulting behaviour and issue/accepted scope. Include operator release notes for command or workflow changes.

## Validation

- Base and candidate SHA
- Commands, environment and passed/failed/skipped results
- Acceptance cases and their evidence or explicit gaps
- Live Octopus result, approved test target reference and cleanup, or applicability reason
- Architecture/LikeC4 and help/README updates where affected

## Independent review and human gates

- Reviewer identity, reviewed SHA, verdict and unresolved findings
- Local operator walkthrough approval and SHA where required
- Publication authority
- Hosted run URLs, tested SHA and pending checks

Keep evidence sanitised. New changes invalidate affected checks and approvals. Merge and release require their separate authority.
